categories.main_business_segments: COSCO SHIPPING Holdings Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: container shipping and terminal operations. The container shipping segment includes international and domestic container transportation services through subsidiaries such as COSCO SHIPPING Lines and OOIL. The terminal segment involves container and bulk cargo terminal operations globally via COSCO SHIPPING Ports. The company also engages in related logistics and supply chain services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital technologies including blockchain-based platforms (GSBN) for electronic bills of lading and supply chain digitization. It employs modern shipbuilding techniques focusing on green and low-carbon technologies, such as methanol dual-fuel container ships and biofuel applications. The company also integrates intelligent systems for supply chain control towers, smart warehousing, and automated terminal operations to enhance efficiency and sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: COSCO SHIPPING serves global customers involved in international trade, including industries like automotive, home appliances, cross-border e-commerce, lithium batteries, and photovoltaics. Its services cover cargo owners, freight forwarders, and logistics providers. The company’s markets span major global trade routes including trans-Pacific, Asia-Europe, intra-Asia, and emerging markets in Latin America, Africa, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a presence in approximately 145 countries and regions, covering about 629 ports worldwide. Key geographic markets include the Americas, Europe, Asia-Pacific, China mainland, and other international regions. It maintains a balanced global network with significant operations in China, Europe, the Mediterranean, Middle East, Southeast Asia, South America, and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: COSCO SHIPPING operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the maritime supply chain. It controls container shipping fleets (midstream) and terminal operations (downstream), providing integrated logistics and supply chain services. The company also invests in upstream and downstream logistics resources to enhance its supply chain ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities focus on digital transformation and green low-carbon development. It emphasizes innovation in digital supply chain products, blockchain applications, and intelligent terminal automation. R&D efforts target green shipping technologies including methanol dual-fuel vessels and biofuels, as well as smart port infrastructure and energy efficiency improvements to lead sustainable maritime operations.
categories.revenue_model: COSCO SHIPPING generates revenue mainly through container shipping freight charges and terminal handling fees. Additional income streams include logistics and supply chain service fees, ship leasing, and ancillary maritime services. The company also earns investment income from equity holdings and financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: COSCO SHIPPING is one of the world’s largest container shipping and terminal operators, ranking among the top globally by fleet size and terminal throughput. It competes with major global shipping alliances and terminal operators such as Maersk, MSC, CMA CGM, and Hapag-Lloyd. The company maintains a leading position through scale, global network coverage, and integrated digital and green initiatives.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, COSCO SHIPPING reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 233.86 billion, a 33.29% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 49.1 billion, more than doubling from the previous year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 497.47 billion with a net asset return rate of 22.6%. It has a strong cash position of RMB 184.19 billion and continues to invest heavily in fleet expansion and terminal infrastructure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: COSCO SHIPPING emphasizes its integrated global digital supply chain platform centered on container shipping, combining scale, network breadth, and advanced digital and green technologies. Its dual-brand strategy (COSCO SHIPPING Lines and OOIL) offers complementary services with extensive route coverage. The company differentiates through its commitment to sustainability, pioneering green shipping solutions, and providing customized, intelligent supply chain products that enhance customer value and supply chain resilience.
